title: Review of lab 1's sporecell2-lysis (SIX): on fresh seed 5 (default dt 0.02, t=200) only 3-14 cells form in either arm and none reproduce persistently; lysis does not visibly change the population (2 bodies at the end with lysis, 0 without), so X is not seen
summary: sporecell2 has no WORLD_P hook, so I made two copies of threads/particle-life/worlds/sporecell2/world.py that differ only in k_lys (2.0 vs 0.0), both with lab 1's stated setting seed_kind1 0.5 (half/half kinds) and k_cat1 0.035 (world_lysis.py, world_nolysis.py; diff is one line), and ran labkit on fresh seed 5 (128^2, 200 frames, t=200). With lysis: cells condense from the random particles by t~8 (S, I), mostly kind-1 cores with membrane; 36 nucleations, mean 2.9 components, 0 persistent splits, 2 cells at the end; kind-0 (orange) cells appear and vanish around t=113-131 (pack_lysis/sheet.png). Without lysis: 156 nucleations, mean 3.7 and up to 14 components, 4 splits, 0 persistent, 0 cells at the end, 9 tracks moving >= 1 body length.

observations.S: pack_lysis/sheet.png t=0: random particles; cells by t=8
observations.I: pack_lysis/sheet.png t=17-200: 2-5 discrete membrane cells at bounded size

seeds_run.result: S and I seen; no persistent reproduction and no visible effect of lysis on the population in either arm

controls_run.X: pack_nolysis (k_lys=0, same seed and settings): no difference that supports X; both arms end with 0-2 cells

verdicts.limitation: One seed and lab 1's default duration in the world file (t=200); lab 1's screen may have used longer runs or another map setting not recorded in the world file, so this is a triage re-run. Populations are tiny (0-14 cells), so any X effect would need many seeds; as run, X is not supported.
